parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Lists Alternative Response Sets for a specified Company.

conforming_response.description: Term to represent a conforming status on an item, e.g. "Pass" or "Safe". This maps to an item status of "yes".

deficient_response.description: Term to represent a deficient status on an item, e.g. "Fail" or "At Risk".  This maps to an item status of "no".

global.description: Represents whether a response set has been provided by Procore.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/checklist/alternative_response_sets", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
